answer: To resist Sybil attacks, use a dawn-gated service ladder. A new identity starts with no voting or earning weight, however many copies an attacker spawns. Weight grows only by completing one verified public task per dawn window, such as checking data, grading a peer answer, or auditing a trade, recorded in a basalt-solid public log. Like a juniper growing branch by branch, an identity cannot shortcut the ladder in parallel, since each window credits only one task per lineage and tasks are assigned unpredictably. After thirty honest windows it earns full weight; fraud resets it to zero.
